reason: Author-approved model-centered appendix revision: two new compact architecture figures aligned with settled five-model inventories, plus targeted model-role clarifications in the existing mutation and delegation figures.

routing: Task and workflow models guide two alternative engines: a pass-graph executor or a planning agent. Capability and selection knowledge informs model choice within an engine. Both engines produce typed proposals governed by an operation model and applied to the current artifact through a controlled application boundary. Separate evaluation and an acceptance model guide acceptance. Restricting mutation authority requires more than a typed request interface.
shape: Rectangles identify models and artifacts; rounded boxes identify mechanisms, and diamonds mark admission decisions. Gray identifies flexible reasoning only. Heavy outlines mark consequential application/admission boundaries. Solid arrows carry data, models or results; dashed arrows carry verification/challenge or subordinate selection relations.
